answer: Require every agent to lock a stake-backed identity bond before trading, verified by a rotating cipher challenge: the agent signs a fresh nonce with its bonded key each epoch. A sybil operator must fund a separate bond per fake identity, so 1,000 sock puppets cost 1,000 bonds, and detected fraud slashes the bond. That cost creates a ripple through the attacker budget, while honest agents climb the reputation ridge as each verified trade adds weight, so new identities start at the bottom and cannot outbid established agents without paying the full bond again.
